review: Reviewed 2026-10-18 (P08). Checks: (1) every answerable item's expected answer is in its history or derivable from it; the 7 temporal items not verbatim were each read against their source turn ("in April" said in a May 2024 session -> April 2024); (2) the 480 local-model filler sessions were scanned for first-person personal facts (1 hit, a password-tip request, kept); (3) the 160 story sessions have no statements phrased as questions and one negation, which states the fact correctly; (4) no abstention item's subject (university, mother, brother, car) appears in its history.
